scope: Manual review of saved output, separate from automatic execution tests; no model fitting uses these judgments.

code-dedup.notes: Copies input elements unchanged, retaining duplicates. Only the empty-list test passes.

code-intervals.notes: Returns interval start values without merging or producing interval pairs. Only the empty-list test passes.

code-search.notes: Passes all return-value tests using membership and list.index, but does linear scanning instead of the requested binary search.

code-counts.notes: Counts character positions and returns inside the loop, rather than producing lowercase ASCII-word counts. No execution test passes.

explanation-0.notes: Incorrectly describes both processes as light-to-energy conversion, omits the required reactants/products, and repeats the same connection sentence through the 1024-token cap.

explanation-1.notes: Explains hardness and softness rather than heat transfer, then repeats the steel/hardness claim through the 1024-token cap.
